description:
Self-onboarding & Top-Up for all 4 Rel-Time Tiers via EITHER Bitcoin Lightning OR Stripe Card Checkout (`POST /v1/agent/invoice` & `POST /v1/agent/claim`). IMPORTANT:
1. Before calling `create_invoice` for a new key, ask the user which tier AND payment method (`lightning` or `stripe`) they want:
   - **Universal Anchor (`pack: 'universal'`, $3 / anchor):** Priority 10-Minute Bitcoin Queue · Standard Mode (Biometric or Anonymous) · Supports `quantity` (default 1).
   - **Agent Launch Pack (`pack: 'launch'`, $5 / 25 Hashes, max 3 per key):** Priority 10-Minute Bitcoin Queue · Standard Mode · Includes Sun-Stamp, 1-Click Stamped Copy (.PDF/.PNG), 4-Plate Certificate, and .JSON Doomsday Proof.
   - **Autonomous Agents (`pack: 'standard'`, $50 / 500 Hashes):** Dynamic 6-Hour Batch Queue · Supports both Temporal Mode (`T_index` sub-second sequencing) and Standard Mode · Reloadable anytime (+500 credits / $50) with zero key rotation.
   - **Rel-Time Superhighway (`pack: 'enterprise'`, $399 / 5,000 Hashes):** Priority 10-Minute Bitcoin Queue · Supports Temporal Mode (`T_index`) & Standard Mode + Data Integrity Audit & Instant Tamper Detection.
2. When `create_invoice` returns:
   - For **Lightning**: ALWAYS present BOTH the scannable QR code image (by calling Read on `qr_code_png_path`) AND the full, un-truncated `ln_invoice` (`bolt11`) string in a copyable code block on the VERY FIRST try!
   - For **Stripe**: The Stripe Checkout page opens automatically in the user's browser; also present the clickable `checkout_url` link and QR code (`qr_code_png_path`). Once paid, call `claim_invoice` with `invoice_id` (`cs_...`) to activate and save the key.

action.description: 'create_invoice' generates a Lightning BOLT11 invoice or Stripe Checkout Session; 'claim_invoice' exchanges a paid Lightning invoice_id or Stripe session_id ('cs_...') for a new API key or reloads an existing API key.

api_key.description: Optional: pass an existing `rel_key_...` key (or omit to use RELTIME_API_KEY if reload_existing is true) to reload Hash Credits into that key without rotating it.

invoice_id.description: Required when action is 'claim_invoice'. Pass either the Strike Lightning `invoice_id` UUID or the Stripe Checkout `session_id` (`cs_...`).

pack.description: REQUIRED for 'create_invoice' after asking the user. Which tier the user selected: 'universal' ($3/anchor), 'launch' ($5 / 25 Hashes, max 3 per key), 'standard' ($50 / 500 Hashes), or 'enterprise' ($399 / 5,000 Hashes — Superhighway). If omitted on 'create_invoice', returns the 4 tier options so you can ask the user.

payment_method.description: REQUIRED for 'create_invoice' after asking the user. Payment method: 'lightning' (Bitcoin Lightning BOLT11 invoice + QR code) or 'stripe' (Stripe Card Checkout URL + browser launch). Never guess — if omitted on 'create_invoice', returns the tier/payment prompt so you can ask the user whether they want Lightning or Stripe.

quantity.description: Optional credit quantity when pack is 'universal' ($3.00 per credit, default 1).

reload_existing.description: If true, reloads Hash Credits into the currently configured RELTIME_API_KEY (or passed `api_key`) instead of generating a new key.

name: reltime_provision_agent_key
